text:
miguel: Starting config-only sweep (cfg-2026-03-21-01). Changes: throttles, timeouts, routing weights, batching windows. Change window 16:30-17:30 PT. Canary 3% for 20m, then gradual. pinning model versions unchanged.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started release cfg-2026-03-21-01 (config-only). Canary targets: tenant:traffic:3%. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/config-sweep-2026

sophie: quick check — batch_window_ms 50 -> 30? that can up CPU on low-qps tails.

ava: saw CPU bump in staging with 30ms but tail latency improved. maybe widen batch for low-qps tenants.

miguel: We're only touching routing_weight for p99-sensitive tenants per PR. No model pins.

kevin: please pin tenant-accounting to tenant floor 0.5 for 2h during rollout. if qps spikes we should rollback that tenant.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1m OK, 10m OK (latency +2ms), 15m CPU +6% on gpu-pool-2, not alarming.

luca: observability note — added alert for kvcache_miss_rate. If >3% for 10m -> rollback.

sophie: heads-up: perf-team scheduled a load test at 16:45. might overlap with canary.

miguel: @sophie good catch. hold canary until load test completes. delaying start 10m.

deploy-bot: Pausing deploy per request by miguel. Canary paused at 0%.

miguel: Load test finished, no regression observed. resuming canary at 16:50.

deploy-bot: Resumed. Canary 3% -> 10%.

ava: seeing a small error uptick (502s) for tenant acct-42, ~3 occurrences. investigating.

miguel: decision: hold at 10% while we investigate. do not roll forward.

kevin: recommend targeted revert for acct-42 routing change (weighted routing revert).

miguel: applying targeted revert: routing.weights.acct-42 = 0.8 -> 1.0 (config-only).

deploy-bot: Apply change for acct-42: OK. Canary stable at 10% (12m).

ava: confirming — no new 502s after revert.

miguel: proceed to gradual rollout: 10% -> 30% (10m), then 60%, then 100% if stable.

deploy-bot: Increasing to 30%.

luca: reminder to record release notes: changes to timeouts, batching windows, routing weights + targeted revert. I will draft.

miguel: thanks. tag ops for follow-up 2h post-deploy.

deploy-bot: Release complete: cfg-2026-03-21-01 rolled to 100% at 17:18 PT. Change window closed.

miguel: closing thread. postmortem-notes if any regressions in next 2h. :thumbsup:
